subject: System Design
title: DNS Attacks and DNSSEC
description: A short lesson to help you apply DNS Attacks and DNSSEC.

hook.text: You visit your bank's website, but a DNS spoofing attack redirects you to a fake one that steals your password.

buildup.text: DNS was designed without security. Attackers can inject fake DNS responses to redirect traffic.

discovery.text: DNSSEC adds cryptographic signatures to DNS records, letting resolvers verify responses are authentic.

twist.text: DNSSEC adoption is slow. Misconfigured DNSSEC can make legitimate domains unreachable.

climax.text: DNS is a critical weakness in internet security. DNSSEC helps, but full adoption remains years away.

punchline.text: DNSSEC proves DNS answers haven't been tampered with.

quiz.question: What does DNSSEC protect against?
options: Fake DNS responses that redirect traffic to malicious servers
